topic: Big Mom tried to swap Lola's twin Chiffon in for the Loki wedding and Loki saw through it (side point of the curse long)
title: Big Mom Tried To Fool Loki With Lola's Twin Sister
description: Big Mom wanted an alliance with the giants, so she tried to fool the prince of Elbaph with Lola's twin sister. Chapter 858 plants the whole story. Was Loki sharp, or just stubborn?
comment: Did Loki spot the swap because he is sharp, or because he really loved Lola? Pick one.

lines.text: Big Mom tried to fool a giant prince with a twin sister, and it failed.

shot.fallback: huge matriarch plotting at a banquet

lines.text: Chapter 858. Big Mom wants an alliance with the giants.

shot.search: Charlotte Linlin Whole Cake Island giants
shot.fallback: giant empress at a cake palace

lines.text: Her plan is a wedding. Lola is the bride, Loki the groom.

shot.fallback: bride and a giant prince beside a church

lines.text: Lola wants no part of it, so she runs.

shot.fallback: bride in a veil sprinting down a road

lines.text: Big Mom doesn't cancel. She sends Lola's twin, Chiffon, to stand in her place.

shot.fallback: two identical sisters in white dresses

lines.text: Same face, same dress, same plan.
Loki sees through it, and the whole wedding collapses.

shot.fallback: giant prince frowning at a bride

lines.text: Here's the detail people forget. He fell for Lola at first sight, and refused her twin.

shot.fallback: giant prince staring at a young woman

lines.text: Maybe he only caught it because he knew Lola's face. Fair. He still turned her sister down.
Chapter 1131 shows his habit: Loki bluffs when he must, so he smells a bluff.

shot.fallback: chained giant grinning at a young pirate

lines.text: My read: Loki doesn't accept substitutes, in love or in anything else.

shot.fallback: grinning giant prince with his tongue out

lines.text: So why did Big Mom want the giants on her side so badly?

shot.fallback: huge woman gazing at a snowy kingdom

lines.text: Which is how an Emperor ended up trying to fool a giant prince...

shot.fallback: huge matriarch plotting at a banquet
